result.title: Representation Learning via Composite Subspace Flow Matching
result.summary: Distilling semantic meaning from raw image data remains a challenge in machine learning. Current self-supervised paradigms face a trade-off: joint-embedding architectures produce relevant features by aggressively discarding intra-class variance, irreversibly spatial and reconstruction. Conversely, generative models preserve spatial details but struggle to isolate semantics, as their optimization is dominated by pixel variations. To bridge this divide, we propose composite subspace flow matching (CSFM). Rather than corrupting data with unstructured isotropic noise, CSFM formulates representation learning as the variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces. By bounding trajectory variance with hard temporal style truncation, a capacity-constrained encoder is driven to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content. Empirical evaluations across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10 show that CSFM yields competitive discriminative transferability while preserving generative synthesis across both convolutional and vision transformer architectures. By avoiding the collapse pathologies of non-generative methods, CSFM forms a smooth latent space that outperforms standard optimal transport flows on linear probing and few-shot classification, while enabling coherent synthesis and trajectory interpolation. These results confirm that steering the physical dynamics of generative flows offers a scalable paradigm for learning representations that are simultaneously linearly separable and generatively invertible.

AI.brief_summary: 提出复合子空间流匹配（CSFM），将自监督表示学习表述为对谱、颜色、光照等子空间确定性退化课程的最小方差反演，并用硬时间风格截断约束轨迹方差，使容量受限编码器忽略瞬时风格、保留持续内容，在 CIFAR/STL-10 上兼顾判别迁移与生成合成。
AI.relevance_reason: 不属于多模态推理主线，但其「分阶段退化课程＋轨迹方差上界」迫编码器区分持续内容与瞬变风格，可能为 latent 状态中视觉细节的保留与无关变化的筛选提供可核查线索，流匹配潜空间轨迹与插值也可对照 latent 状态生成与几何结构。
